answer.text:
Only Sales Systems, Sales Operations, Channel Operations, Deal Desk, and Finance have the ability to change the owner of an opportunity in Salesforce. There is an exception: if the opportunity is owned by an SDR/BDR, they are able to assign it to their AE. Only these approved profiles will have the appropriate buttons in Salesforce to change owners. If you need an update to the opportunity owner, you should tag @sales-support in Salesforce Chatter on the opportunity record you want to update.

Owner: Sales Systems, Sales Operations, Channel Operations, Deal Desk, Finance

nodes.text: Only Sales Systems, Sales Operations, Channel Operations, Deal Desk, and Finance have the ability to change the opportunity owner in Salesforce (unless the opportunity is owned by an SDR/BDR where they are able to assign to their AE).
